text_block_list.text: One day during the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
C'mere, c'mere.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Could I borrow a moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Alright, no one's around... perfect.
choice_data_list: Something important you wanted to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's really nothing major.
Just about training...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly speaking, what do you think
I'm lacking right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, saying stuff like "we're lacking everything!"
is off-limits for now, okay? It just makes me sad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'd like to use it as a reference for my solo training, so could you give me the specifics?
choice_data_list: Sure, but what brought this on all of a sudden?
Sure, but what's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, since I've been running in races,
I haven't trained as much as everyone else, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's just that
we have our showdown with Teio coming up, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know it's super-duper, CRA~ZY hard, okay?
I know, but still.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I just wanted to do
everything I could, you know~?

Though she still seems anxious,
she clearly has the drive to fight.
In that case, the advice I can give her right now is—
choice_data_list: We should train our core at the beach.
Let's apply some mental pressure.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho...
And what's the reasoning behind that?

I suggested training on unstable sand to strengthen her core
and stabilize her running form during races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see... Stability is important, after all.
Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Then let's get right to it—
choice_data_list: Still, self-training is forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why...?
Even though you gave me advice.
choice_data_list: As long as I'm watching, it's fine.
As long as it's in front of me, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Does that mean
you'll come with me...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, um, I'm sorry, okay?
Even though you must have other work to do."
choice_data_list: There's no job more important than supporting you.
There's no job more important than supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, she says the most embarrassing things
without batting an eye...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
M-Mental strain...
Just what are you planning on making us do... !?
"I suggested introducing constraints, such as time limits for each workout, to help her get used to the mental pressure."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see~.
Thank goodness, it wasn't anything weird...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I understand the logic, so let's get right to—
choice_data_list: Still, self-training is forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why...?
Even though you gave me advice.
choice_data_list: As long as I'm watching, it's fine.
As long as it's in front of me, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Does that mean
you'll come with me...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, um, I'm sorry, okay?
Even though you must have other work to do."
choice_data_list: There's no job more important than supporting you.
There's no job more important than supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, she says the most embarrassing things
without batting an eye...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――Alright!
Guess I'll head back to training~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sorry for troubling you.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, why did you go out of your way to move?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, um...
See, I just thought it'd be a waste to talk about it in front of other people.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you'd teach me your secret recipe, Trainer.
Is it like a trade secret or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, I'd rather die
than let anyone hear that it's to fight Teio."

It seems Nice Nature still
hasn't found her confidence...
